name: Lentil Shepherd's Pie
summary: Saucy lentils and vegetables under a mashed potato crust. Vegan.
instructions: Simmer the lentils in plenty of water for 20 minutes until tender. Drain.
Meanwhile, boil the potatoes until soft, then mash with the butter and a splash of water. Season.
Heat the oil in a wide oven-safe pan. Cook the onion and carrots 6–7 minutes, then add the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Stir in the cooked lentils, frozen vegetables, and 250 mL water. Simmer 5 minutes and season well.
Spread the mashed potato over the top. Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes until golden.
budgetNotes: Green or brown lentils hold their shape; red lentils go mushy here.
Use up any leftover vegetables in the filling.
Assembles ahead and bakes straight from the fridge — add 10 minutes.
